description: Figure 2, titled "Individual vs Ensemble Models," is a line plot that compares the reliability of different models. The x-axis represents the model type, which includes "GPT-4 + Opus," "FT GPT-3.5 + GPT-4," "FT GPT-3.5 + Opus," and "All." The y-axis represents the reliability score, with values ranging from approximately 65 to 85. The plot shows two lines: one for RS0 and one for RS10. The RS0 line starts at 84.57 for "GPT-4 + Opus," increases to 85.08 for "FT GPT-3.5 + Opus," and then decreases to 82.6 for "All." The RS10 line starts at 65.72 for "GPT-4 + Opus," increases to 73.09 for "FT GPT-3.5 + Opus," and then decreases to 74.89 for "All." The plot demonstrates that the ensemble models generally have higher reliability scores compared to individual models.
